body: Opened from the 2026-06-15 retraining-decision session. Root finding: the recall frontier is column-level-ambiguous boundaries unreachable by BOTH the flat-softmax retrain (additive route dead 0-for-5) and deterministic guards (currency gold cols are bare numbers, no in-value signal). Design is option 2 of the prior ship-gate fork (output/late-fusion/ac07_ship_gate_decision.md): a BOUNDED boundary arbiter, NOT the general replacement that collapsed twice. Strongest first boundary = tight-code-vs-alphanumeric (value-decisive, proven 17->93%). Currency is gated on ac-03 (column-context view) — honest scope: ship value-decisive boundaries first.

SUPERSEDED before any work — do not implement. Investigation (same day) found this spec's lead premise is broken: the value-level expert it relies on is a poor witness (right on only 3.6% of its disagreements with v19; the family-A 17->93% win cited in ac-01 was the ADDITIVE head, not the expert standalone — output/late-fusion/deferral_finding.md). The better-grounded mechanism for the SAME column-level-ambiguity target is sibling-context attention, which is already built and was stranded at integration. Replaced by spec 2026-06-16-finish-sibling-context-attention. See memory sibling-context-is-the-stranded-architecture-layer.
